preview.notReady: Fix the errors below before you activate.

problems.NO_ENTRY_STATUS: No status where new orders start
problems.MANY_ENTRY_STATUSES: More than one status where new orders start
problems.NO_CLOSING_STATUS: No status that ends the order
problems.INVALID_STATUS_FLAGS: A status cannot both start and end an order
problems.DUPLICATE_NAME: The same name is used twice
problems.NO_INITIAL_STATE: An item type has no state that new lines start in
problems.MANY_INITIAL_STATES: An item type has more than one state that new lines start in
problems.INVALID_STATE_FLAGS: A state's choices contradict each other or the type
problems.UNKNOWN_EXPIRY_STATE: The expiry state is not one of the type's states
problems.UNKNOWN_CELL: A grid cell names a status, type or state that does not exist
problems.CLOSING_CELL: A status that ends the order cannot have grid cells
problems.STATE_CANNOT_LEAVE: Lines in this state can never move on
problems.LINE_BLOCKED: A line cannot move to the state the grid sets

preview.legend: Solid: hard hold. Hatched: soft hold. Outline: no hold.
preview.blocked: Cannot move as the grid says
